prompts: Create a landscape concept render for Duck Rails cooperative VR game. Low-poly 3D game environment with visibly coarse point-filtered pixel textures on simple economical meshes, Quackville style. Modern battered utility railway, no steam-era architecture or photorealism. Underground safe starting station inside a mountain. Exactly one straight track between two broad raised side platforms, each approximately 10m wide and 24m long; 6m track channel. Platform height 1m above track. Station ceiling 8.6m above track. At REAR only a single transverse footbridge at 6.1m above track spans the two platforms, stairs along BOTH OUTER walls climb toward that rear bridge with intermediate landings; no upper rooms. Front platform end enters enclosed 48m long single-track departure tunnel, 8m wide 7m high, leading to mountain exterior at night. West supplies room at front outer corner; east small staff and storage rooms at front outer corner. Clear 3m inner platform circulation strips. Materials: worn concrete, stained ivory plaster over faded olive paint, occasional exposed brick, oxidized steel railings, timber bench, worn yellow platform edges. Sparse practical warm lamps in cool dark atmosphere, readable floor and architecture, shadowed recesses. Dressing restrained and out of circulation. No enemies, fountain, hub gate, extra tracks or lavish props. No written lettering; blank signboards for later CutePixel labels. Render as a visual finish proposal, not a diagram, no watermark. VIEW 1: Wide establishing view from rear west platform looking toward front departure tunnel. Supplies entrance on left ahead, staff/store doors across track on right ahead, timber waiting bench. The overhead rear bridge is just above/behind camera, partial edge can frame top. Include a compact worn teal open-deck utility rail trolley parked on center track, about 5m wide 10m long, modest front cockpit facing tunnel, small coal furnace, no passenger coaches. Strong spatial clarity and quiet welcoming starting area against dark tunnel.
